old_value: {"id":"project-LICHEN-1ojj.12","title":"lichen_lora_l2_get_eui64: returns pointer to static mutable data without const enforcement","description":"In lora_l2.h line 129, lichen_lora_l2_get_eui64() returns 'const uint8_t *' pointing to lora_state.eui64 (lora_l2.c line 328). The const is advisory - callers can cast it away. The EUI-64 is used as the interface's link address (lichen_l2.c copies it to iface_link_addr at line 352 to avoid this). However, any caller that mutates the returned pointer corrupts the node's identity. This is a footgun for contributors: the API looks like a getter but returning a pointer to internal state invites misuse. Consider: return by value (8 bytes) or document the aliasing hazard prominently.","status":"open","priority":1,"issue_type":"task","owner":"me@mark.atwood.name","created_at":"2026-06-27T05:47:39.434943Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","updated_at":"2026-06-27T05:57:13.042004Z","closed_at":"2026-06-27T05:57:13.042004Z","close_reason":"Closed","labels":["maintainer-burden","owner-reserved","review","risk"],"dependencies":[{"issue_id":"project-LICHEN-1ojj.12","depends_on_id":"project-LICHEN-1ojj","type":"parent-child","created_at":"2026-06-27T05:47:39.435418Z"}]}

new_value: Already fixed in current HEAD by a prior review-fix wave; verified incl. caller audit, no further change needed. Both remedies the bead offered were implemented: (1) new by-value API lichen_lora_l2_copy_eui64(uint8_t out[8]) (lora_l2.h:270, lora_l2.c:1172) copies the EUI-64 under lora_mutex with full state validation, and header docs say 'Prefer lichen_lora_l2_copy_eui64() for all new code'; (2) the compat lichen_lora_l2_get_eui64() aliasing hazard is documented prominently in header (lora_l2.h:~279-290) and implementation (lora_l2.c:1209-1216, thread-safety contract: pointer aliases internal state, no mutex held after return, caller must prevent concurrent deinit). Caller audit (rg across repo): lichen_lora_l2_get_eui64 has ZERO remaining call sites in firmware/ - every caller (lichen_l2.c peer_add/peer_remove/enable/iface_init, lines 669/781/1067/1497) migrated to copy_eui64, so no mutation of the returned pointer is possible; net_if link address uses the static iface_link_addr copy (lichen_l2.c:444). Return type remains const uint8_t * as the bead notes. CI gap: verification was caller audit + compile of the consuming TU (lichen_l2.c clang -fsyntax-only ARM32: exit 0, zero diagnostics); native_sim / pinned Zephyr v3.7.0 build not runnable locally.
